question: What counts as japa for one risen in the unartificial heart?
premises: risen in this unmade heart, whatever one does
whether by breath or by reflection
all of it counts as his japa
inference: Naturalized japa: every act and breath is recitation.
plain_english: Risen in this unartificial heart, whatever one does — by breath or reflection — all of it is held to be his japa.
